metric: accuracy on a shared held-out evaluation set

permutation_test.definition: exact test over all orderings of the rung means against log10(n_units)
permutation_test.note: with this many rungs the p-value is coarse; the bootstrap interval is the primary evidence and the permutation test is a sanity check

primary_fit.definition: mean score regressed on log10(n_units); units = score points per 10x data
primary_fit.name: points_per_decade

secondary_fit.definition: log10(1 - mean score) regressed on log10(n_units); more negative = faster error decay
secondary_fit.name: error_exponent
